The specimen was located in a ditch beside the road among a dense growth of very tall grasses and wildflowers. The ditch bordered a warehouse property with a large lawn. The temperature was 21 degrees Celsius and the air was very still, almost no wind. The specimen was moving very quickly and only landed for a few seconds making it difficult to document a photograph.

Remarks: On September 26th at 10:21 am one specimen was observed in Cornwall, Ontario. The location was a large freshly cut lawn. It was 23 degrees Celsius and sunny with a very light breeze.
Comment: On September 26th 2014 at 10:21 am one specimen was observed near 1330 Optimum Drive in Cornwall Ont. The subject was observed on a large property with a well kept lawn. Little diversity of vegetation was observed, with the only a few dandelions and clovers among the grass. The specimen landed on the grass for about a minute and was not bothered by me getting quite close in order take a photograph. It was 23 degrees Celsius, sunny and there was only a very light breeze.
